profiles.name: It's For Your Own Good
chars: If Aradia Madellan is slain as a result of Perials of the Warp whilst within 6" of a friendly COMMISSAR, she is executed before anything untoward can happen - the power she was attempting to still fails, but units within 6" of her do not suffer D3 mortal wounds as normal.

profiles.name: Psychic Augment
chars: If manifested, select a friendly ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY unit within 12" of the psyker. Add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by that unit until the start of your next Psychic phase.

profiles.name: Smite
chars: If manifested, the closest visible enemy unit within 18" of the psyker suffers 1 mortal wound. If the result of the Psychic test was more than 10 the target suffers D3 mortal wounds instead.

profiles.name: Been There, Seen It, Killed It
chars: You can re-roll failed wound rolls made for Colonel 'Iron Hand' Straken in the Fight phase when targeting enemy MONSTERS.

profiles.name: Cold Steel and Courage
chars: All models in friendly CATACHAN units within 6" of Colonel 'Iron Hand' Straken at the start of the Fight phase can make 1 additional attack each time they fight during that phase.

profiles.name: Voice of Command
chars: This unit may issue one order per turn to the soldiers under their command at the start of their Shooting phase. Orders may only be issued to INFANTRY units within 6" of this unit that have the same <REGIMENT> keyword as this unit. To issue an order, pick a target unit and choose which order you wish to issue from the table below. A unit may only be affected by one order per turn.

profiles.name: Senior Officer
chars: This model may use the Voice of Command ability twice in each of your turns.  Resolve the effects of the first order before issuing the second order.

profiles.name: Refractor Field
chars: This model has a 5+ invulnerable save.

profiles.name: Shotgun
chars: Add 1 to this weapons strength if within 1/2 range.

profiles.name: Plasma pistol, Supercharge
chars: On a hit roll of 1, the bearer is slain.

profiles.name: Take Aim!
chars: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 for all the models in the ordered unit until the end of the phase.

profiles.name: First Rank, Fire! Second Rank, Fire!
chars: All lasguns and all hot-shot lasguns in the ordered unit change their Type to Rapid Fire 2 until the end of the phase.

profiles.name: Bring it Down!
chars: Re-roll wound rolls of 1 for all the models in the ordered unit until the end of the phase.

profiles.name: Forwards, for the Emperor!
chars: The ordered unit can shoot this phase even if it Advanced in its Movement phase.

profiles.name: Get back in the Fight!
chars: The ordered unit can shoot this phase even if it Fell Back in its Movement phase.

profiles.name: Move! Move! Move!
chars: Instead of shooting this phase the ordered unit immediately moves as if it were the Movement phase. It must Advance as part of this move, and cannot declare a charge during this turn.

profiles.name: Fix Bayonets!
chars: This order can only be issued to units that are within 1" of an enemy unit. The ordered unit immediately fights as if it were the Fight phase.

profiles.name: Burn Them Out!
chars: You can re-roll the dice when determining the number of attacks the ordered unit can make with flamers and heavy flamers until the end of the phase. In addition, units targeted by models from the ordered unit with these weapons do not gain any bonus to their saving throws for being in cover this phase.

profiles.name: Fire on My Command!
chars: The ordered unit can shoot at enemy units that are within 1" of friendly units until the end of the phase, but each time you roll a hit roll of 1 for such an attack, resolve that attack against a friendly unit within 1" of the target unit instead. You may choose which friendly unit is hit. This order may not be issued to a unit which is within 1" of an enemy unit.

profiles.name: Repel the Enemy!
chars: Until the end of the phase, the ordered unit can fire any of its weapons while it is within 1" of the enemy, regardless of the weapon’s type. If they do so, they must target enemy units within 1", even if friendly units are within 1" of these units.

profiles.name: Mount Up!
chars: Until the end of the phase, the ordered unit can shoot and then immediately embark within a friendly ARMAGEDDON TRANSPORT VEHICLE, as long as all models in the unit are within 3" of the vehicle. This order may not be issued to a unit which disembarked in the preceding Movement phase.

profiles.name: Elimination Protocol Sanctioned!
chars: You can re-roll failed wound rolls for models from the ordered unit when attacking any enemy VEHICLES or MONSTERS this phase.

profiles.name: Form Firing Squad!
chars: Until the end of the phase, the ordered unit can target CHARACTERS with their Rapid Fire weapons, even if they are not the closest enemy unit.

profiles.name: Lead From the Front
chars: This Warlord can perform a Heroic Intervention if, after the enemy has completed all their charge moves, they are within 6" of any enemy units. This Warlord can move up to 6" when performing a Heroic Intervention, so long as they end the move closer to the nearest enemy model. In addition, if your Warlord charged, was charged or performed a Heroic Intervention, then until the end of the turn you can re-roll failed hit rolls made for them.

profiles.name: Power Field
chars: Commisar Yarrick has a 4+ invulnerable save.

profiles.name: Hero of Hades Hive
chars: You can re-roll hit rolls of 1 made for friendly ASTRA MILITARUM units within 6" of Commissar Yarrick.  You may re-roll and failed hit rolls for friendly ASTRA MILITARUM units within 6" of Commissar Yarrick when attacking ORK units.

profiles.name: Iron Will

profiles.name: Summary Execution

chars: Roll a dice each time a friendly <Sub-faction>model within 6" of this model is slain in the Fight phase. On a 6, the unit that made the attack that slew the model suffers 1 mortal wound after it has finished making its attacks.

profiles.name: 64: Strike and Fade

profiles.name: 65: Final Strike

profiles.name: 66: Direct Fire

profiles.name: 05: Improved Sights
chars: Pick one of this model’s ranged weapons. Add 6" to that weapon’s Range characteristic.

profiles.name: 07: Artificer Weapon

chars: Pick one of this model’s melee weapons. Improve that weapon’s AP characteristic by 1 (e.g. AP -1 becomes AP -2).

profiles.name: 3: Master of Lore

profiles.name: 02: Old War Wound
chars: Select a result from this table, or roll 2D6 to randomly select a result (re-roll if you get this result again). Subtract or worsen this model’s characteristic by the amount described in the result you picked instead of adding or improving it (e.g. if the Ferocious Combatant result was selected, an Attacks characteristic of 3 would become 2, while if the Dead-eyed result was selected, a BS of 3+ would become 4+)

profiles.name: 03: Courageous
chars: Add 1 to this model’s Leadership characteristic.

profiles.name: 04: Ferocious Combatant
chars: Add 1 to this model’s Attacks characteristic.

profiles.name: 05: Mighty

profiles.name: 06: Dead-eyed

profiles.name: 07: Fleet

profiles.name: 08: Blademaster
chars: Improve this model’s Weapon Skill characteristic by 1 (e.g. WS 3+ will become WS 2+), to a maximum of 2+.

profiles.name: 09: Enhanced Physiology
chars: Add 1 to this model’s Toughness characteristic.

profiles.name: 10: Toughened Armor
chars: Improve this model’s Save characteristic by 1 (e.g. Sv 5+ will become Sv 4+), to a maximum of 2+.

profiles.name: 11: Divine Protection

profiles.name: Field Commander
chars: Use this Stratagem before the battle if you used any Specialist Detachment Stratagems when choosing your army. Choose one CHARACTER from your army that has gained a keyword from a Specialist Detachment Stratagem that is not your Warlord and is not a named character. You can give that character the Warlord Trait of the Specialist Detachment they are part of (note that this character is only regarded as your Warlord for the purpose of that Warlord Trait). This Stratagem can only be used once for each Specialist Detachment Stratagem you have used (spend 1 CP each time you use it). No two characters can have the same Warlord Trait.

profiles.name: Knight Commander

profiles.name: Tank Orders (Pask)

To issue a Tank Order, pick a target LEMAN RUSS within 6" of Knight Commander Pask and choose which order you wish to issue from the Tank Orders table.  Each LEMAN RUSS can only be given a single order each turn.

profiles.name: Explodes (6+/6"/D3)

profiles.name: Smoke Launchers

profiles.name: Grinding Advance
chars: If this model remains stationary or moves under half speed in its Movement phase (i.e. it moves a distance in inches less than half of its current Move characteristic) it can shoot its turret weapon twice in the following Shooting phase (the turret weapon must target the same unit both times). Furthermore, hit rolls for this model’s turret weapon do not suffer the penalty for moving and shooting a Heavy weapon. The following weapons are turret weapons: battle cannon, Conqueror battle cannon, Demolisher cannon, Eradicator nova cannon, Executioner plasma cannon, Exterminator autocannon, Punisher gatling cannon, Stygies Vanquisher battle cannon, twin lascannon and Vanquisher battle cannon.

profiles.name: Emergency Plasma Vents

profiles.name: Heavy flamer

profiles.name: Vanquisher Battle Cannon

profiles.name: Executioner Plasma Cannon - Supercharge

profiles.name: Eradicator Nova Cannon

profiles.name: Gunners, Kill on Sight!

profiles.name: Pound Them to Dust!
chars: For the duration of this phase, you can re-roll the dice when determining the number of attacks the ordered model can make with turret weapons (as described in the Grinding Advance ability above) that use a randomly determined number (e.g. Heavy D6).

profiles.name: Get Around Behind Them!
chars: The ordered model can move up to 6" in this phase, either before or after it shoots, as if it were the Movement phase. This does not affect how far the vehicle has moved for the purposes of determining how many times it can fire its turret weapon (as described in the Grinding Advance ability above).

profiles.name: Superior Tactical Training
chars: Roll a dice each time your Warlord issues an order or tank order. On a 4+ that order can affect an additional CADIAN unit of the same type as the original target (INFANTRY or LEMAN RUSS) within 6" of the Warlord.

profiles.name: Augur array

profiles.name: Dozer blade

profiles.name: Track guards

profiles.name: Hunter-killer missile

profiles.name: Supreme Commander

profiles.name: Tactical Genius

chars: After deployment, but before the first battle round begins, choose a unit in your opponent’s army. You can re-roll failed wound rolls for ASTRA MILITARUM units from your army that target the unit you chose whilst they are within 6" of your Warlord.

profiles.name: Legendary Fighter
chars: If this warlord charges in the charge phase, add 1 to their attacks characteristic until the end of the ensuing fight phase.

profiles.name: Inspiring Leader
chars: Friendly units within 6" of this warlord can add 1 to their leadership characteristic.

profiles.name: Tenacious Survivor
chars: Roll a dice each time this warlord loses a wound. On a 6, the warlord shrugs off the damage and does not lose the wound.

profiles.name: 11: Inspirational Fighter
chars: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 in the Fight phase for friendly <Sub-faction> units within 6" of this model.

profiles.name: 12: Beast Hunter
chars: You can re-roll failed wound rolls for attacks made by this model in the Fight phase if the target is a MONSTER unit.

profiles.name: 13: Heroic
chars: This model can perform a Heroic Intervention if, after the enemy has completed all of their charge moves, it is within 6" of any enemy units, and can move up to 6" when doing so.

profiles.name: 14: Duelist
chars: Add 1 to this model’s Strength and Attacks characteristics while it is within 1" of any enemy Character units.

profiles.name: 15: Zealot
chars: You can re-roll failed hit rolls for this model in the Fight phase if it made a charge move, performed a Heroic Intervention, or was charged this turn.

profiles.name: 16: Deadly Charge
chars: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this model in the Fight phase if it made a charge move this turn.

profiles.name: 21: Targeting Augury
chars: Enemy units do not gain the benefit of cover to their saving throws against attacks made by friendly <Sub-faction> units within 6" of this model when the attack is made.

profiles.name: 22: Directed Fire
chars: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 in the Shooting phase for friendly <Sub-faction> units within 6" of this model.

profiles.name: 23: Deadly Marksman
chars: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of ranged weapons used by this model.

profiles.name: 24: Sundering Shots
chars: Each wound roll of 6+ made for this model’s ranged attacks inflicts 1 mortal wound on the target in addition to any normal damage.

profiles.name: 25: Keen Eye
chars: This model can target enemy CHARACTER units in the Shooting phase even if they are not the closest enemy model.

profiles.name: 26: Defensive Fighter
chars: When this model fires Overwatch, it successfully hits on rolls of 5 or 6, instead of only 6.

profiles.name: 31: Grudge
chars: You can re-roll any hit, wound and damage rolls made for this model’s attacks that target the enemy Warlord.

profiles.name: 32: Resilient
chars: Each time this model loses a wound, roll a dice; on a 5+ it does not lose that wound.

profiles.name: 33: Camoflage
chars: Add 2 instead of 1 to saving throws made for this model when it is receiving the benefit of cover.

profiles.name: 34: Stealth Assault
chars: Enemy units cannot fire Overwatch at this model.

profiles.name: 35: Indomitable
chars: All damage suffered by this model is halved (rounding up).

profiles.name: 36: Impervious
chars: This model regains 1 lost wound at the start of your turn.

profiles.name: 41: Infiltrator
chars: During deployment, you can set up this model in ambush, instead of placing it on the battlefield. At the end of any of your Movement phases it can reveal its location – set it up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 9" from any enemy models.

profiles.name: 42: Stealthy
chars: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made with ranged weapons that target this model.

profiles.name: 43: Hard to Kill
chars: Wound rolls of 1, 2 or 3 made for attacks that target this model always fail, even if the attack has a Strength characteristic higher than this model’s Toughness characteristic.

profiles.name: 44: Strategic Feint
chars: At the start of the first battle round but before the first turn begins, you can pick a friendly <Sub-faction> unit within 6" of this model and set it up again, anywhere wholly within your deployment zone. If your opponent has any units with similar abilities, roll off; starting with the winner of the roll-off, take it in turns to resolve these abilities.

profiles.name: 45: Swift Strike
chars: You can always choose this model to fight first in the Fight phase even if it did not charge. If the enemy has units that have charged, or that have a similar ability, alternate choosing units to fight with, starting with the player whose turn is taking place.

profiles.name: 46: Foresight
chars: Once per battle, if this model is on the battlefield, you can re-roll one hit roll, wound roll, damage roll or saving throw.

profiles.name: 51: Inspirational Leader
chars: Friendly <Sub-faction>units can use this model’s Leadership instead of their own while they are within 6" of it.

profiles.name: 52: Rallying Cry
chars: You can re-roll failed Morale tests for friendly <Sub-faction>units while they are within 6" of this model.

profiles.name: 53: Icon of Retribution
chars: Roll a dice each time a friendly <Sub-faction>model within 6" of this model is slain in the Fight phase. On a 6, the unit that made the attack that slew the model suffers 1 mortal wound after it has finished making its attacks.

profiles.name: 54: Impetuous
chars: You can re-roll failed charge rolls for this model.

profiles.name: 55: Terrifying
chars: Subtract 1 from the Leadership characteristic of enemy units while they are within 3" of this model.

profiles.name: 56: Savage Riposte
chars: Each time you roll an unmodified saving throw of 6 for this model in the Fight phase, the enemy unit that made the attack suffers 1 mortal wound after it has resolved all of its attacks.

profiles.name: 61: Air Strike
chars: Once per battle, in your Shooting phase, you can pick an enemy unit, other than a Characterunit, that is visible to this model and roll a D6. On a 1-4 nothing happens. On a 5+ the target unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

profiles.name: 62: Swift Advance
chars: When this model Advances, add 6" to its Move characteristic for that Movement phase instead of rolling a D6

profiles.name: 63: Reactive Tactics
chars: This model, and friendly<Sub-faction>units within 6" of them, can charge even if they Fell Back that turn.

profiles.name: 64: Strike and Fade
chars: After this model has fought in the Fight phase, it can immediately pile in D3+3" in any direction, not just towards the closest enemy model.

profiles.name: 65: Final Strike
chars: If this model is slain, you can select an enemy unit within 3" of it and roll a D6; on a 2+ that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

profiles.name: 66: Direct Fire
chars: Each time you make a wound roll of 6+ in the Shooting phase for a friendly <Sub-faction>unit within 6" of this model, the AP characteristic of that attack is improved by 1 (e.g. AP -1 becomes AP -2).

profiles.name: 02: Auto-loader
chars: Pick one of this model’s ranged weapons. Increase the number of shots this weapon makes by 1 (e.g. a Pistol 1 weapon becomes a Pistol 2 weapon).

profiles.name: 03: Penetrator Rounds
chars: Pick one of this model’s ranged weapons. Improve that weapon’s AP characteristic by 1 (e.g. AP -1 becomes AP -2).

profiles.name: 04: High Calibre
chars: Pick one of this model’s ranged weapons. Add 1 to that weapon’s Strength characteristic.

profiles.name: 05: Improved Sights
chars: Pick one of this model’s ranged weapons. Add 6" to that weapon’s Range characteristic.

profiles.name: 06: Inferno Round
chars: Pick one of this model’s ranged weapons. Add the following ability to that weapon: ‘Units do not receive the benefit of cover to their saving throws against attacks made with this weapon.’

profiles.name: 07: Artificer Weapon
chars: Pick one of this model’s weapons. Add 1 to that weapon’s Damage characteristic.

profiles.name: 08: Finely Balanced
chars: Pick one of this model’s melee weapons. Add the following ability to that weapon: ‘Each time the bearer fights, it can make 1 additional attack with this weapon.’

profiles.name: 09: Shredder
chars: Pick one of this model’s melee weapons. Add the following ability to that weapon: ‘You can re-roll failed wound rolls for attacks made with this weapon.’

profiles.name: 10: Brutal
chars: Pick one of this model’s melee weapons. Improve that weapon’s Strength characteristic by 1 (e.g. User becomes +1, +1 becomes +2).

profiles.name: 11: Razor-edged
chars: Pick one of this model’s melee weapons. Improve that weapon’s AP characteristic by 1 (e.g. AP -1 becomes AP -2).

profiles.name: 12: Heirloom
chars: Pick one of this model’s melee weapons. Add the following ability to that weapon: ‘Each unmodified hit roll of 6 made for attacks with this weapon scores 2 hits instead of 1’.

profiles.name: 1: Psychic Might
chars: Add 1 to the number of psychic powers this character can attempt to manifest in your Psychic phase.

profiles.name: 2: Adamantium Will
chars: Add 1 to the number of psychic powers this character can attempt to deny in your opponent’s Psychic phase.

profiles.name: 3: Master of Lore
chars: Add 1 to the number of psychic powers this model knows from one of the psychic disciplines available to them.

profiles.name: 02: Old War Wound
chars: Select a result from this table, or roll 2D6 to randomly select a result (re-roll if you get this result again). Subtract or worsen this model’s characteristic by the amount described in the result you picked instead of adding or improving it (e.g. if the Ferocious Combatant result was selected, an Attacks characteristic of 3 would become 2, while if the Dead-eyed result was selected, a BS of 3+ would become 4+)

profiles.name: 03: Courageous
chars: Add 1 to this model’s Leadership characteristic.

profiles.name: 04: Ferocious Combatant
chars: Add 1 to this model’s Attacks characteristic.

profiles.name: 05: Mighty
chars: Add 1 to this model’s Strength characteristic.

profiles.name: 06: Dead-eyed
chars: Improve this model’s Ballistic Skill characteristic by 1 (e.g. BS 3+ will become BS 2+), to a maximum of 2+.

profiles.name: 07: Fleet
chars: Add 2" to this model’s Move characteristic.

profiles.name: 08: Blademaster
chars: Improve this model’s Weapon Skill characteristic by 1 (e.g. WS 3+ will become WS 2+), to a maximum of 2+.

profiles.name: 09: Enhanced Physiology
chars: Add 1 to this model’s Toughness characteristic.

profiles.name: 10: Toughened Armor
chars: Improve this model’s Save characteristic by 1 (e.g. Sv 5+ will become Sv 4+), to a maximum of 2+.

profiles.name: 11: Divine Protection
chars: Improve this model’s invulnerable save by 1 (e.g. an invulnerable save of 5+ will become an invulnerable save of 4+), to a maximum of 3+. If this model does not have an invulnerable save, it instead gains a 6+ invulnerable save.

profiles.name: 12: Heroic Constitution
chars: Add 1 to this model’s Wounds characteristic.

profiles.name: Field Commander
chars: Use this Stratagem before the battle if you used any Specialist Detachment Stratagems when choosing your army. Choose one CHARACTER from your army that has gained a keyword from a Specialist Detachment Stratagem that is not your Warlord and is not a named character. You can give that character the Warlord Trait of the Specialist Detachment they are part of (note that this character is only regarded as your Warlord for the purpose of that Warlord Trait). This Stratagem can only be used once for each Specialist Detachment Stratagem you have used (spend 1 CP each time you use it). No two characters can have the same Warlord Trait.

profiles.name: Mechanized Commander
chars: OFFICERfrom your army with the Voice of Command ability only. Your Warlord can issue orders whilst embarked within an EMPEROR’S BLADE CHIMERA orEMPEROR’S BLADE TAUROX(measuring ranges from any point on the vehicle) and is treated as being within 3" of a vox-caster. When doing so, these orders can only be issued to friendly EMPEROR’S BLADE units.

profiles.name: Unflinching Resolve
chars: You can re-roll hit rolls when your Warlord, and friendly EMPEROR’S FIST units within 6" of your Warlord, fire Overwatch.

profiles.name: Lord of Ordnance
chars: Each time you roll a wound roll of 6+ for an attack made by a friendly EMPEROR’S WRATH unit while they are within 6" of your Warlord in the Shooting phase, the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack is improved by 1 (i.e. AP0 becomes AP-1, AP-1 becomes AP-2).

profiles.name: Fiery Denouncer
chars: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 for your Warlord and friendly EMPEROR’S CONCLAVE units within 6" of your Warlord in the Fight phase.

profiles.name: Grave-Chute Commando
chars: Add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by friendly TEMPESTUS DROP FORCE INFANTRY units that disembarked from a friendlyTEMPESTUS DROP FORCE VALKYRIE this turn while they are within 6" of your Warlord.

profiles.name: It's For Your Own Good
chars: If Aradia Madellan is slain as a result of Perials of the Warp whilst within 6" of a friendly COMMISSAR, she is executed before anything untoward can happen - the power she was attempting to still fails, but units within 6" of her do not suffer D3 mortal wounds as normal.

profiles.name: 1) Terrifying Visions
chars: Choose an enemy unit within 18" of the psyker. That unit subtracts 2 from its Leadership until the start of your next turn.

profiles.name: 2) Gaze of the Emperor
chars: Draw a straight line 2D6" long directly away from the psyker. Roll a die for each model the center of the line passes over. On a 4+ that model's unit suffers a mortal wound.

profiles.name: 3) Psychic Barrier
chars: Select a friendly ASTRA MILITARUM unit within 12" of the psyker. Until the start of your next Psychic phase, add 1 to that unit's saving throws.

profiles.name: 4) Nightshroud
chars: Choose a friendly ASTRA MILITARUM unit within 12" of the psyker. Until the start of your next turn, any enemy unit that targets the chosen unit with a ranged weapon suffers a -1 penalty to its hit rolls.

profiles.name: 5) Mental Fortitude
chars: Select a friendly ASTRA MILITARUM unit within 12" of the psyker. Until the start of your next Psychic phase, that unit automatically passes Morale tests.

profiles.name: 6) Psychic Maelstrom
chars: Select an enemy unit within 18" of the psyker. Roll at D6. On a 2+, that unit suffers a mortal wound. Unless this mortal wound is negated, you can ten roll another die. On a 3+ that enemy unit suffers another mortal wound. Continue this process, adding 1 to the die roll required each time (so the next roll would need a 4+, than 5+, etc.) until you fail to cause a mortal wound, or the enemy unit is destroyed.

profiles.name: The Blade of Conquest
chars: Model with power sword only. The Blade of Conquest replaces the model’s power sword and has the following profile:

profiles.name: The Laurels of Command
chars: OFFICER with Voice of Command ability only. Roll a dice each time the bearer issues an order to a friendly <REGIMENT>unit within 6" of them. On a 4+ the bearer can immediately issue another order to the same unit. This does not count towards the maximum number of orders this model may issue each turn.

profiles.name: Mamorth Tuskblade
chars: CATACHAN model with power sword only. The Mamorph Tuskblade replaces the model’s power sword and has the following profile:

profiles.name: The Deathmask of Ollanius
chars: INFANTRY model only. The bearer of this item has a 4+ invulnerable save. In addition, once per game, at the start of any of your turns, the bearer may immediately heal D3 wounds.

profiles.name: The Dagger of Tu'Sakh
chars: During deployment, you can set up the bearer and one ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY unit from your army behind enemy lines instead of placing them on the battlefield. The infantry unit must have the same <REGIMENT> keyword as the bearer if the bearer has one.At the end of any of your Movement phases these units can launch their daring attack – set them up within 3" of each other, anywhere on the battlefield that is wholly within 6" of any battlefield edge and more than 9" away from any enemy models.

kids.name: Relic (Tallarn): Claw of the Desert Tigers

profiles.name: Claw of the Desert Tigers
chars: Each time the bearer fights, it can make 2 additional attacks with this weapon.

profiles.name: Claw of the Desert Tigers
chars: TALLARN model with power sword only. Claw of the Desert Tigers replaces the model’s power sword and has the following profile:

profiles.name: Relic of Lost Cadia
chars: CADIAN model only. Once per battle, the bearer can unveil this relic at the start of any turn. Until the end of that turn, you can re-roll hit and wound rolls of 1 for all CADIAN units within 12" of the bearer. You can instead re-roll all failed hit and wound rolls for these units until the end of the turn if they are targeting a CHAOS unit.

kids.name: Relic (Vostroyan): The Armour of Graf Toschenko

profiles.name: The Armour of Graf Toschenko
chars: VOSTROYAN INFANTRY model only. Increase the model’s Toughness characteristic to 4 and Save characteristic to 2+.

kids.name: Relic (Mordian): Order of the Iron Star of Mordian

profiles.name: Order of the Iron Star of Mordian
chars: MORDIAN INFANTRY model only. Each time the bearer suffers a wound or mortal wound, roll a dice; on a 4+ the wound is negated and has no effect.

kids.name: Relic (Militarum Tempestus): The Tactical Auto-Reliquary of Tyberius

profiles.name: The Tactical Auto-Reliquary of Tyberius
chars: MILITARUM TEMPESTUS model only. When using the Voice of Command ability, this model can issue one additional order per turn. Roll a dice before issuing this additional order. On a roll of 1, the Reliquary issues contradictory nonsense and nothing happens.

profiles.name: The Emperor's Benediction
chars: COMMISSAR or LORD COMMISSAR with a bolt pistol only. The Emperor’s Benediction replaces the model’s bolt pistol and has the following profile:

profiles.name: The Emperor's Benediction
chars: This weapon can target a Character even if it is not the closest enemy unit, unless the bearer is within 1" of an enemy unit.

profiles.name: Skull Mask of Acheron
chars: ARMAGEDDON CHARACTER only. Enemy units within 3" of the bearer suffer a -1 penalty to their Leadership. ORK units suffer a -2 penalty instead.

profiles.name: Kurov's Aquila
chars: OFFICERS only. Each time your opponent uses a Stratagem, roll a D6. On a 5+ you gain 1 Command Point.

kids.name: Relic (Tempestus Drop Force): Cypra Mundi Null-Emitter

profiles.name: Cypra Mundi Null-Emitter
chars: If the bearer is targeted or affected by a psychic power, roll a D6; on a 2+ the psychic power has no effect on the bearer.

kids.name: Relic (Emperor's Conclave): Litanies of The Holy Synod

profiles.name: Litanies of The Holy Synod
chars: If a friendly EMPEROR’S CONCLAVE unit within 6" of the bearer takes a Morale test, roll two D6 and use the lowest result to determine the outcome of the Morale test. In addition, if the bearer is slain, before removing the model from the battlefield, pick another friendly EMPEROR’S CONCLAVE unit within 6" of the bearer. For the rest of the battle that unit does not have to take Morale tests and can add 1 to its Attacks characteristic.

profiles.name: Agripinaa-Class Orbital Tracker
chars: In your Shooting phase, pick an EMPEROR’S WRATH unit from your army within 6" of the bearer. Until the end of that phase, enemy units do not receive the benefit of cover when targeted by shooting attacks made by that unit.

profiles.name: Hammer of Sunderance
chars: Model with battle cannon only. Hammer of Sunderance replaces the bearer’s battle cannon and has the following profile:

profiles.name: The Shield of Mortwald
chars: The bearer has a 3+ invulnerable save, which cannot be re-rolled for any reason. The first time this invulnerable save is failed, the Shield of Mortwald ceases to function for the rest of the battle.

Subtract or worsen this model’s characteristic by the amount described in the result you picked instead of adding or improving it (e.g. if the Ferocious Combatant result was selected, an Attacks characteristic of 3 would become 2, while if the Dead-eyed result was selected, a BS of 3+ would become 4+)

profiles.name: 03: Courageous
chars: Add 1 to this model’s Leadership characteristic.

profiles.name: 04: Ferocious Combatant
chars: Add 1 to this model’s Attacks characteristic.

profiles.name: 05: Mighty
chars: Add 1 to this model’s Strength characteristic.

profiles.name: 06: Dead-eyed
chars: Improve this model’s Ballistic Skill characteristic by 1 (e.g. BS 3+ will become BS 2+), to a maximum of 2+.

profiles.name: 07: Fleet
chars: Add 2" to this model’s Move characteristic.

profiles.name: 08: Blademaster
chars: Improve this model’s Weapon Skill characteristic by 1 (e.g. WS 3+ will become WS 2+), to a maximum of 2+.

profiles.name: 09: Enhanced Physiology
chars: Add 1 to this model’s Toughness characteristic.

profiles.name: 10: Toughened Armor
chars: Improve this model’s Save characteristic by 1 (e.g. Sv 5+ will become Sv 4+), to a maximum of 2+.

profiles.name: 11: Divine Protection
chars: Improve this model’s invulnerable save by 1 (e.g. an invulnerable save of 5+ will become an invulnerable save of 4+), to a maximum of 3+. If this model does not have an invulnerable save, it instead gains a 6+ invulnerable save.

profiles.name: 12: Heroic Constitution
chars: Add 1 to this model’s Wounds characteristic.

profiles.name: Ex-gang Leader
chars: Add 1 to this Warlord’s Attacks characteristic. In addition, add 1 to any wound rolls made for your Warlord in the Fight phase.

profiles.name: Superior Tactical Training
chars: Roll a dice each time your Warlord issues an order or tank order. On a 4+ that order can affect an additional CADIAN unit of the same type as the original target (INFANTRY or LEMAN RUSS) within 6" of the Warlord.

profiles.name: Swift Attacker
chars: Your Warlord and all friendly TALLARN units within 6" of them can charge even if they Fell Back that turn.

profiles.name: Honoured Duellist
chars: Re-roll failed hit and wound rolls in the Fight phase for attacks made by your Warlord.

kids.name: WT (Millitarum Tempestus): Faithful Servant of the Throne

profiles.name: Faithful Servant of the Throne
chars: Your Warlord can attempt to deny one psychic power in each enemy Psychic phase in the same manner as a Psyker.

profiles.name: Tenacious
chars: Roll a dice each time your Warlord suffers a wound or mortal wound. On a 5+, the wound is ignored. If your Warlord has the VEHICLE keyword, the wound is ignored on a roll of a 6+ instead.

profiles.name: Iron Discipline
chars: Roll a dice for each model that flees from any friendly MORDIAN units within 6" of your Warlord in the Morale phase. On a 4+, that model does not flee.

profiles.name: Lead From the Front
chars: This Warlord can perform a Heroic Intervention if, after the enemy has completed all their charge moves, they are within 6" of any enemy units. This Warlord can move up to 6" when performing a Heroic Intervention, so long as they end the move closer to the nearest enemy model. In addition, if your Warlord charged, was charged or performed a Heroic Intervention, then until the end of the turn you can re-roll failed hit rolls made for them.

profiles.name: Mechanized Commander
chars: OFFICERfrom your army with the Voice of Command ability only. Your Warlord can issue orders whilst embarked within an EMPEROR’S BLADE CHIMERA orEMPEROR’S BLADE TAUROX(measuring ranges from any point on the vehicle) and is treated as being within 3" of a vox-caster. When doing so, these orders can only be issued to friendly EMPEROR’S BLADE units.

profiles.name: Unflinching Resolve
chars: You can re-roll hit rolls when your Warlord, and friendly EMPEROR’S FIST units within 6" of your Warlord, fire Overwatch.

profiles.name: Lord of Ordnance
chars: Each time you roll a wound roll of 6+ for an attack made by a friendly EMPEROR’S WRATH unit while they are within 6" of your Warlord in the Shooting phase, the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack is improved by 1 (i.e. AP0 becomes AP-1, AP-1 becomes AP-2).

profiles.name: Fiery Denouncer
chars: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 for your Warlord and friendly EMPEROR’S CONCLAVE units within 6" of your Warlord in the Fight phase.

profiles.name: Grave-Chute Commando
chars: Add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by friendly TEMPESTUS DROP FORCE INFANTRY units that disembarked from a friendlyTEMPESTUS DROP FORCE VALKYRIE this turn while they are within 6" of your Warlord.

chars: You can re-roll failed Morale tests for friendly ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY units within 6" of your Warlord in the Morale phase.

profiles.name: Grand Strategist
chars: Whilst your Warlord is alive, you can re-roll a single hit roll, wound roll or saving throw per battle. In addition, if your army is Battle-forged and this Warlord is on the battlefield, roll a D6 for each Command Point you spend to use a Stratagem; on a 5+ that Command Point is immediately refunded.

profiles.name: Implacable Determination
chars: When your Warlord and a single friendly unit within 3" of them Advances, they may both add 6" to their Move characteristic for that Movement phase instead of rolling a dice

profiles.name: Master of Command
chars: Your Warlord gains the Voice of Command ability. If your Warlord already has the Voice of Command or Tank Orders ability, they may instead issue one additional order per turn.

profiles.name: Bellowing Voice
chars: Add 3" to the range of any abilities on your Warlord’s datasheet (such as Aura of Discipline or Voice of Command).

profiles.name: Old Grudges
chars: After deployment, but before the first battle round begins, choose a unit in your opponent’s army. You can re-roll failed wound rolls for ASTRA MILITARUM units from your army that target the unit you chose whilst they are within 6" of your Warlord.

profiles.name: Legendary Fighter
chars: If this warlord charges in the charge phase, add 1 to their attacks characteristic until the end of the ensuing fight phase.

profiles.name: Inspiring Leader
chars: Friendly units within 6" of this warlord can add 1 to their leadership characteristic.

profiles.name: Tenacious Survivor
chars: Roll a dice each time this warlord loses a wound. On a 6, the warlord shrugs off the damage and does not lose the wound.

profiles.name: Field Commander
chars: Use this Stratagem before the battle if you used any Specialist Detachment Stratagems when choosing your army. Choose one CHARACTER from your army that has gained a keyword from a Specialist Detachment Stratagem that is not your Warlord and is not a named character. You can give that character the Warlord Trait of the Specialist Detachment they are part of (note that this character is only regarded as your Warlord for the purpose of that Warlord Trait). This Stratagem can only be used once for each Specialist Detachment Stratagem you have used (spend 1 CP each time you use it). No two characters can have the same Warlord Trait.

profiles.name: Loner
chars: Officers cannot issue orders to Sly Marbo. Sly Marbo can never have a Warlord Trait.

profiles.name: Lethal Ambush
chars: During deployment, you can set up Sly Marbo in ambush instead of placing him on the battlefield. At the end of any of your Movement phases he can emerge from hiding and attack -- set him up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 9" away from any enemy models. Sly Marbo can then do one of the actions in the Lethal Ambush table below.

profiles.name: One With His Surroundings
chars: If Sly Marbo receives the benefit of cover, add 2 to his saving throws instead of 1.

profiles.name: Like Fighting a Shadow
chars: Once per battle, at the start of any of your Movement phases, Sly Marbo can disappear as long as there are no enemy models within 6" of him. If he does, remove him from the battlefield. At the end of your next Movement phase he reappears using the Lethal Ambush abillty.

profiles.name: Stalk with the Blade
chars: Sly Marbo can immediately move up to D6" in any direction. In addition, until the start of your next turn, add 2 to Sly Marbo's Attacks characteristic.

profiles.name: Snipe with the Pistol
chars: Sly Marbo can immediately shoot his ripper pistol as if it were the Shooting phase (doing so does not prevent him from shooting in the Shooting phase of this turn). In addition, unitil the start of your next turn, Sly Marbo can target enemy CHARACTERS when he shoots his ripper pistol even if another enemy unit is closer.

profiles.name: Detonate Concealed Explosives
chars: Pick an enemy unit on the battlefield and roll a D6. Subtract 1 from the result if the unit is a CHARACTER, but add 1 if the unit contains 10 or more models. On a 4+ that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds, but on a 7+ it suffers D6 mortal wounds.

profiles.name: Ripper Pistol
chars: This weapon wounds INFANTRY units on a roll of 2+.

profiles.name: Envenomed Blade
chars: This weapon wounds INFANTRY units on a roll of 2+.

profiles.name: Tank Orders
chars: This model can issue one order each turn to a friendly <REGIMENT> LEMAN RUSS at the start of your Shooting phase.  To issue a Tank Order, pick a target LEMAN RUSS within 6" of this model and choose which order you wish to issue from the Tank Orders table.  Each LEMAN RUSS can only be given a single order each turn.

profiles.name: Explodes (6+/6"/D3)
chars: If this model is reduced to 0 wounds, roll a D6 before removing it from the battlefield and before any embarked models disembark. On a 6 it explodes, and each unit within 6" suffers D3 mortal wounds.

profiles.name: Smoke Launchers
chars: Once per game, instead of shooting any weapons in the Shooting phase, this model can use its Smoke Launchers; until your next Shooting phase your opponent must subtract 1 from all hit rolls for ranged weapons that target this vehicle.

profiles.name: Grinding Advance
chars: If this model remains stationary or moves under half speed in its Movement phase (i.e. it moves a distance in inches less than half of its current Move characteristic) it can shoot its turret weapon twice in the following Shooting phase (the turret weapon must target the same unit both times). Furthermore, hit rolls for this model’s turret weapon do not suffer the penalty for moving and shooting a Heavy weapon. The following weapons are turret weapons: battle cannon, Conqueror battle cannon, Demolisher cannon, Eradicator nova cannon, Executioner plasma cannon, Exterminator autocannon, Punisher gatling cannon, Stygies Vanquisher battle cannon, twin lascannon and Vanquisher battle cannon.

profiles.name: Emergency Plasma Vents
chars: If this model fires a supercharged plasma cannon, and you roll one or more hit rolls of 1, it is not automatically destroyed. Instead, for each hit roll of 1, the bearer suffers 1 mortal wound after all of this weapon's shots have been resolved.

profiles.name: Heavy flamer
chars: This weapon automatically hits its target

profiles.name: Multi-melta
chars: If the target is within half range of this weapon, roll two dice when inflicting damage and discard the lowest result.

profiles.name: Plasma cannon, Supercharge
chars: On a hit roll of 1, the bearer is slain after all of this weapon's shots have been resolved.

profiles.name: Heavy flamer
chars: This weapon automatically hits its target

profiles.name: Vanquisher Battle Cannon
chars: Roll two dice when inflicting damage with this weapon and discard the lowest result.

profiles.name: Executioner Plasma Cannon - Supercharge
chars: For each hit roll of 1, the bearer suffers 1 mortal wound after all of this weapon's shots have been resolved.

profiles.name: Eradicator Nova Cannon
chars: Units attacked by this weapon do not gain any bonus to their saving throws for being in cover.

profiles.name: Full Throttle!
chars: Instead of shooting this phase the ordered model immediately moves as if it were the Movement phase. It must Advance as part of this move, and cannot declare a charge during this turn.

profiles.name: Gunners, Kill on Sight!
chars: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 for the ordered model until the end of the phase.

profiles.name: Strike and Shroud!
chars: This order can only be issued to a model that has not yet used its smoke launchers during the battle. The ordered model can shoot its weapons and launch its smoke launchers during this phase.

profiles.name: Pound Them to Dust!
chars: For the duration of this phase, you can re-roll the dice when determining the number of attacks the ordered model can make with turret weapons (as described in the Grinding Advance ability above) that use a randomly determined number (e.g. Heavy D6).

profiles.name: Get Around Behind Them!
chars: The ordered model can move up to 6" in this phase, either before or after it shoots, as if it were the Movement phase. This does not affect how far the vehicle has moved for the purposes of determining how many times it can fire its turret weapon (as described in the Grinding Advance ability above).

profiles.name: The Laurels of Command
chars: OFFICER with Voice of Command ability only. Roll a dice each time the bearer issues an order to a friendly <REGIMENT>unit within 6" of them. On a 4+ the bearer can immediately issue another order to the same unit. This does not count towards the maximum number of orders this model may issue each turn.

profiles.name: The Deathmask of Ollanius
chars: INFANTRY model only. The bearer of this item has a 4+ invulnerable save. In addition, once per game, at the start of any of your turns, the bearer may immediately heal D3 wounds.

profiles.name: The Dagger of Tu'Sakh
chars: During deployment, you can set up the bearer and one ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY unit from your army behind enemy lines instead of placing them on the battlefield. The infantry unit must have the same <REGIMENT> keyword as the bearer if the bearer has one.At the end of any of your Movement phases these units can launch their daring attack – set them up within 3" of each other, anywhere on the battlefield that is wholly within 6" of any battlefield edge and more than 9" away from any enemy models.

chars: Each time the bearer fights, it can make 2 additional attacks with this weapon.

profiles.name: Relic of Lost Cadia
chars: CADIAN model only. Once per battle, the bearer can unveil this relic at the start of any turn. Until the end of that turn, you can re-roll hit and wound rolls of 1 for all CADIAN units within 12" of the bearer. You can instead re-roll all failed hit and wound rolls for these units until the end of the turn if they are targeting a CHAOS unit.

chars: VOSTROYAN INFANTRY model only. Increase the model’s Toughness characteristic to 4 and Save characteristic to 2+.

chars: MORDIAN INFANTRY model only. Each time the bearer suffers a wound or mortal wound, roll a dice; on a 4+ the wound is negated and has no effect.

profiles.name: The Tactical Auto-Reliquary of Tyberius
chars: MILITARUM TEMPESTUS model only. When using the Voice of Command ability, this model can issue one additional order per turn. Roll a dice before issuing this additional order. On a roll of 1, the Reliquary issues contradictory nonsense and nothing happens.

chars: This weapon can target a Character even if it is not the closest enemy unit, unless the bearer is within 1" of an enemy unit.

profiles.name: Skull Mask of Acheron
chars: ARMAGEDDON CHARACTER only. Enemy units within 3" of the bearer suffer a -1 penalty to their Leadership. ORK units suffer a -2 penalty instead.

profiles.name: Kurov's Aquila
chars: OFFICERS only. Each time your opponent uses a Stratagem, roll a D6. On a 5+ you gain 1 Command Point.

chars: If the bearer is targeted or affected by a psychic power, roll a D6; on a 2+ the psychic power has no effect on the bearer.

profiles.name: Litanies of The Holy Synod
chars: If a friendly EMPEROR’S CONCLAVE unit within 6" of the bearer takes a Morale test, roll two D6 and use the lowest result to determine the outcome of the Morale test. In addition, if the bearer is slain, before removing the model from the battlefield, pick another friendly EMPEROR’S CONCLAVE unit within 6" of the bearer. For the rest of the battle that unit does not have to take Morale tests and can add 1 to its Attacks characteristic.

profiles.name: Agripinaa-Class Orbital Tracker
chars: In your Shooting phase, pick an EMPEROR’S WRATH unit from your army within 6" of the bearer. Until the end of that phase, enemy units do not receive the benefit of cover when targeted by shooting attacks made by that unit.

profiles.name: The Shield of Mortwald
chars: The bearer has a 3+ invulnerable save, which cannot be re-rolled for any reason. The first time this invulnerable save is failed, the Shield of Mortwald ceases to function for the rest of the battle.

chars: You can re-roll failed wound rolls for attacks made by this model in the Fight phase if the target is a MONSTER unit.

profiles.name: 13: Heroic
chars: This model can perform a Heroic Intervention if, after the enemy has completed all of their charge moves, it is within 6" of any enemy units, and can move up to 6" when doing so.

profiles.name: 14: Duelist
chars: Add 1 to this model’s Strength and Attacks characteristics while it is within 1" of any enemy Character units.

profiles.name: 15: Zealot
chars: You can re-roll failed hit rolls for this model in the Fight phase if it made a charge move, performed a Heroic Intervention, or was charged this turn.

profiles.name: 16: Deadly Charge
chars: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this model in the Fight phase if it made a charge move this turn.

profiles.name: 21: Targeting Augury
chars: Enemy units do not gain the benefit of cover to their saving throws against attacks made by friendly <Sub-faction> units within 6" of this model when the attack is made.

profiles.name: 22: Directed Fire
chars: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 in the Shooting phase for friendly <Sub-faction> units within 6" of this model.

profiles.name: 23: Deadly Marksman
chars: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of ranged weapons used by this model.

profiles.name: 24: Sundering Shots
chars: Each wound roll of 6+ made for this model’s ranged attacks inflicts 1 mortal wound on the target in addition to any normal damage.

profiles.name: 25: Keen Eye
chars: This model can target enemy CHARACTER units in the Shooting phase even if they are not the closest enemy model.

profiles.name: 26: Defensive Fighter
chars: When this model fires Overwatch, it successfully hits on rolls of 5 or 6, instead of only 6.

profiles.name: 31: Grudge

profiles.name: Reign of Confusion
chars: If you have any models with this ability in your army, then during the first battle round you must roll a dice each time your opponent spends Command Points (CPs) to use a Stratagem. On a 4+, your opponent must spend one extra CP to use that Stratagem, or else it has no effect (the CPs spend so far are lost). This ability cannot affect Stratagems used 'before the battle begins'.

profiles.name: Polymorphine
chars: During deployment, you can set up this model in disguise instead of placing it on the battlefield.  At the end of any of your Movement phases this model can revert to its true form - set it up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than D6+3" away from any enemy models.  For example if you roll a 4, the model can be set up anywhere that is more than 7" from any enemy model.

rules.name: Lightning Reflexes
rules.text: A model with this special rule has a 4+ invulnerable save.

rules.name: Independent Operative
rules.text: This Model can never have a Warlord Trait. During deployment, you can set this model up in concealment instead of placing it on the battlefield. At the end of any of your movement phases, this model can reveal it's position - set it up anywhere on the battlefield that is more then 9" from any enemy model.

rules.name: Execution Force
rules.text: So long as your Warlord is from the IMPERIUM, you can include this unit in a Vanguard Detachment even if that Detachment contains no HQ units. However, if you do so, that Detachment's Command Benefits are changed to 'None' unless that Detachment contains exactly 1 of each assassin.

Take Aim!
chars: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 for all the models in the ordered unit until the end of the phase.

profiles.name: First Rank, Fire! Second Rank, Fire!
chars: All lasguns and all hot-shot lasguns in the ordered unit change their Type to Rapid Fire 2 until the end of the phase.

profiles.name: Bring it Down!
chars: Re-roll wound rolls of 1 for all the models in the ordered unit until the end of the phase.

profiles.name: Forwards, for the Emperor!
chars: The ordered unit can shoot this phase even if it Advanced in its Movement phase.

profiles.name: Get back in the Fight!
chars: The ordered unit can shoot this phase even if it Fell Back in its Movement phase.

profiles.name: Move! Move! Move!
chars: Instead of shooting this phase the ordered unit immediately moves as if it were the Movement phase. It must Advance as part of this move, and cannot declare a charge during this turn.

profiles.name: Fix Bayonets!
chars: This order can only be issued to units that are within 1" of an enemy unit. The ordered unit immediately fights as if it were the Fight phase.

profiles.name: Burn Them Out!
chars: You can re-roll the dice when determining the number of attacks the ordered unit can make with flamers and heavy flamers until the end of the phase. In addition, units targeted by models from the ordered unit with these weapons do not gain any bonus to their saving throws for being in cover this phase.

profiles.name: Fire on My Command!
chars: The ordered unit can shoot at enemy units that are within 1" of friendly units until the end of the phase, but each time you roll a hit roll of 1 for such an attack, resolve that attack against a friendly unit within 1" of the target unit instead. You may choose which friendly unit is hit. This order may not be issued to a unit which is within 1" of an enemy unit.

profiles.name: Repel the Enemy!
chars: Until the end of the phase, the ordered unit can fire any of its weapons while it is within 1" of the enemy, regardless of the weapon’s type. If they do so, they must target enemy units within 1", even if friendly units are within 1" of these units.

profiles.name: Mount Up!
chars: Until the end of the phase, the ordered unit can shoot and then immediately embark within a friendly ARMAGEDDON TRANSPORT VEHICLE, as long as all models in the unit are within 3" of the vehicle. This order may not be issued to a unit which disembarked in the preceding Movement phase.

profiles.name: Elimination Protocol Sanctioned!
chars: You can re-roll failed wound rolls for models from the ordered unit when attacking any enemy VEHICLES or MONSTERS this phase.

profiles.name: Form Firing Squad!
chars: Until the end of the phase, the ordered unit can target CHARACTERS with their Rapid Fire weapons, even if they are not the closest enemy unit.

profiles.name: Ex-gang Leader
chars: Add 1 to this Warlord’s Attacks characteristic. In addition, add 1 to any wound rolls made for your Warlord in the Fight phase.

profiles.name: Superior Tactical Training
chars: Roll a dice each time your Warlord issues an order or tank order. On a 4+ that order can affect an additional CADIAN unit of the same type as the original target (INFANTRY or LEMAN RUSS) within 6" of the Warlord.

profiles.name: Swift Attacker
chars: Your Warlord and all friendly TALLARN units within 6" of them can charge even if they Fell Back that turn.

profiles.name: Honoured Duellist
chars: Re-roll failed hit and wound rolls in the Fight phase for attacks made by your Warlord.

kids.name: WT (Millitarum Tempestus): Faithful Servant of the Throne

profiles.name: Faithful Servant of the Throne
chars: Your Warlord can attempt to deny one psychic power in each enemy Psychic phase in the same manner as a Psyker.

profiles.name: Tenacious
chars: Roll a dice each time your Warlord suffers a wound or mortal wound. On a 5+, the wound is ignored. If your Warlord has the VEHICLE keyword, the wound is ignored on a roll of a 6+ instead.

profiles.name: Iron Discipline
chars: Roll a dice for each model that flees from any friendly MORDIAN units within 6" of your Warlord in the Morale phase. On a 4+, that model does not flee.

profiles.name: Lead From the Front
chars: This Warlord can perform a Heroic Intervention if, after the enemy has completed all their charge moves, they are within 6" of any enemy units. This Warlord can move up to 6" when performing a Heroic Intervention, so long as they end the move closer to the nearest enemy model. In addition, if your Warlord charged, was charged or performed a Heroic Intervention, then until the end of the turn you can re-roll failed hit rolls made for them.

chars: You can re-roll hit rolls when your Warlord, and friendly EMPEROR’S FIST units within 6" of your Warlord, fire Overwatch.

profiles.name: Lord of Ordnance
chars: Each time you roll a wound roll of 6+ for an attack made by a friendly EMPEROR’S WRATH unit while they are within 6" of your Warlord in the Shooting phase, the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack is improved by 1 (i.e. AP0 becomes AP-1, AP-1 becomes AP-2).

profiles.name: Fiery Denouncer
chars: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 for your Warlord and friendly EMPEROR’S CONCLAVE units within 6" of your Warlord in the Fight phase.

profiles.name: Grave-Chute Commando
chars: Add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by friendly TEMPESTUS DROP FORCE INFANTRY units that disembarked from a friendlyTEMPESTUS DROP FORCE VALKYRIE this turn while they are within 6" of your Warlord.

profiles.name: 22: Directed Fire
chars: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 in the Shooting phase for friendly <Sub-faction> units within 6" of this model.

chars: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of ranged weapons used by this model.

profiles.name: 32: Resilient

chars: Add 2 instead of 1 to saving throws made for this model when it is receiving the benefit of cover.

chars: Enemy units cannot fire Overwatch at this model.

chars: All damage suffered by this model is halved (rounding up).

profiles.name: 36: Impervious
chars: This model regains 1 lost wound at the start of your turn.

chars: During deployment, you can set up this model in ambush, instead of placing it on the battlefield. At the end of any of your Movement phases it can reveal its location – set it up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 9" from any enemy models.

chars: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made with ranged weapons that target this model.

profiles.name: 44: Strategic Feint
chars: At the start of the first battle round but before the first turn begins, you can pick a friendly <Sub-faction> unit within 6" of this model and set it up again, anywhere wholly within your deployment zone. chars: Once per battle, if this model is on the battlefield, you can re-roll one hit roll, wound roll, damage roll or saving throw.

chars: You can re-roll failed Morale tests for friendly <Sub-faction>units while they are within 6" of this model.

chars: You can re-roll failed charge rolls for this model.

chars: Subtract 1 from the Leadership characteristic of enemy units while they are within 3" of this model.

chars: Pick one of this model’s ranged weapons. Add 1 to that weapon’s Strength characteristic.

rules.name: Acts of Faith
rules.text:
Roll a D6 at the start of each of your turns. On a 2+ one units from yoru army with this ability can perform an Act of Faith chosen from the following list:

Hand of the Emperor: The unit can immediately move as if it were the Movement phase.

Divine Guidance: The unit can immediately shoot as if it were the Shooting phase.

The Passion: The unit can, if it is within 1" of an enemy unit, immediately pile in and attack as if it were the Fight phase.

Spirit of the Martyr: One model in the unit recovers D3 lost wounds, or you can return a single slain model to the unit with 1 wound remaining.

rules.name: Shield of Faith
rules.text: Models in this unit have a 6+ invulnerable save. In addition, this unit can attempt to deny one psychic power in each enemy Psychic phase in the same manner as a PSYKER. However, if it does so, instead of rolling 2D6, only roll a single D6; the psychic power is resisted if the roll is greater than the result of the Psychic test that manifested the power. chars: Improve this model’s invulnerable save by 1 (e.g. an invulnerable save of 5+ will become an invulnerable save of 4+), to a maximum of 3+. If this model does not have an invulnerable save, it instead gains a 6+ invulnerable save.

profiles.name: 12: Heroic Constitution
chars: Add 1 to this model’s Wounds characteristic.

profiles.name: Hacking Advance
chars: Each unmodified hit roll of 6 made for Gotfret de Montbard's attacks in the Fight phase scores 2 hits instead of 1.

profiles.name: Servant of the Imperium
chars: Gotfret de Montbard can be included in an ASTRA MILITARUM Detachment without preventing other units in the Detachment from gaining a Regimental Doctrine. Note, however, that Gotfret de Montbard can never benefit from a Regimental Doctrine.

profiles.name: Shield of Faith
chars: Gotfret de Montbard can attempt to deny one psychic power in each enemy Psychic phase in the same manner as a PSYKER. However, instead of rolling 2D6, only roll a single D6; the psychic power is resisted if the roll is greater than the result of the Psychic test that manifested the power.

profiles.name: Zealot
chars: You can re-roll failed hit rolls for Gotfret de Montbard in a turn in which he charged, made a Heroic Intervention, or was charged by an enemy unit.

profiles.name: Ecclesiarchy Battle Conclave
chars: If your army is Battle-forged, this unit does not take up slots in a Detachment that includes any MINISTORUM PRIESTS.

rules.name: Acts of Faith (Gotfret)
rules.text:
If your army includes any models with this ability, you will start the battle with 3 Faith Points, plus 1 additional Faith Point for every 10 models with this ability in your army (rounding down). These can be spent to attempt the Acts of Faith listed below. Each can only be attempted once per battle round, and you must spend one Faith Point each time you do so (if you have no Faith Points remaining, you cannot attempt an Act of Faith). To attempt an Act of Faith, select a unit in your army that has the Acts of Faith ability and then choose the Act of Faith you wish to attempt. Then make a Test of Faith for the unit by rolling a D6; if the result is less than that Act of Faith’s devotion value, or is an unmodified roll of 1, the test fails and nothing happens. Otherwise the test is successful and the Act of Faith takes effect.

Hand of the Emperor
Devotion value 4
Use this Act of Faith at the start of your Movement phase. If successful, add 3" to the selected unit’s Move characteristic until the end of that phase.

Spirit of the Martyr
Devotion value 3
Use this Act of Faith at the start of your Movement phase. If successful, one model in the selected unit regains D3 lost wounds, or, if there are no wounded models and any models in the unit have been slain, you can return one slain model to the unit with 1 wound remaining (this model is set up in unit coherency and cannot be set up within 1" of any enemy models – if it is not possible to place this model, it is not returned to the unit).

Aegis of the Emperor
Devotion value 3
Use this Act of Faith at the start of your opponent’s Psychic phase. If successful, then until the end of that phase, roll a D6 each time the selected unit suffers a mortal wound. On a 4+ that mortal wound is ignored.

Divine Guidance
Devotion value 4
Use this Act of Faith at the start of your Shooting phase. If successful, add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made with this unit’s ranged weapons until the end of the phase.

The Passion
Devotion value 5
Use this Act of Faith at the start of your Fight phase. If successful, the selected unit can be chosen to Fight with twice in that phase, instead of only once.

Light of the Emperor
Devotion value 3
Use this Act of Faith at the start of the Morale phase. If successful, the selected unit automatically passes Morale tests that phase.

chars: A model with a storm shield has a 3+ invulnerable save.

chars: Add 1 to this Warlord’s Attacks characteristic. In addition, add 1 to any wound rolls made for your Warlord in the Fight phase.

profiles.name: Superior Tactical Training
chars: Roll a dice each time your Warlord issues an order or tank order. On a 4+ that order can affect an additional CADIAN unit of the same type as the original target (INFANTRY or LEMAN RUSS) within 6" of the Warlord.

profiles.name: Swift Attacker
chars: Your Warlord and all friendly TALLARN units within 6" of them can charge even if they Fell Back that turn.

profiles.name: Honoured Duellist
chars: Re-roll failed hit and wound rolls in the Fight phase for attacks made by your Warlord.

profiles.name: Faithful Servant of the Throne
chars: Your Warlord can attempt to deny one psychic power in each enemy Psychic phase in the same manner as a Psyker.

profiles.name: Tenacious
chars: Roll a dice each time your Warlord suffers a wound or mortal wound. On a 5+, the wound is ignored. If your Warlord has the VEHICLE keyword, the wound is ignored on a roll of a 6+ instead.

profiles.name: Iron Discipline
chars: Roll a dice for each model that flees from any friendly MORDIAN units within 6" of your Warlord in the Morale phase. On a 4+, that model does not flee.

profiles.name: Lead From the Front
chars: This Warlord can perform a Heroic Intervention if, after the enemy has completed all their charge moves, they are within 6" of any enemy units. This Warlord can move up to 6" when performing a Heroic Intervention, so long as they end the move closer to the nearest enemy model. In addition, if your Warlord charged, was charged or performed a Heroic Intervention, then until the end of the turn you can re-roll failed hit rolls made for them.

chars: OFFICERfrom your army with the Voice of Command ability only. Your Warlord can issue orders whilst embarked within an EMPEROR’S BLADE CHIMERA orEMPEROR’S BLADE TAUROX(measuring ranges from any point on the vehicle) and is treated as being within 3" of a vox-caster. When doing so, these orders can only be issued to friendly EMPEROR’S BLADE units.

profiles.name: Unflinching Resolve
chars: You can re-roll hit rolls when your Warlord, and friendly EMPEROR’S FIST units within 6" of your Warlord, fire Overwatch.

profiles.name: Lord of Ordnance
chars: Each time you roll a wound roll of 6+ for an attack made by a friendly EMPEROR’S WRATH unit while they are within 6" of your Warlord in the Shooting phase, the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack is improved by 1 (i.e. AP0 becomes AP-1, AP-1 becomes AP-2).

profiles.name: Fiery Denouncer
chars: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 for your Warlord and friendly EMPEROR’S CONCLAVE units within 6" of your Warlord in the Fight phase.

chars: Add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by friendly TEMPESTUS DROP FORCE INFANTRY units that disembarked from a friendlyTEMPESTUS DROP FORCE VALKYRIE this turn while they are within 6" of your Warlord.

chars: When your Warlord and a single friendly unit within 3" of them Advances, they may both add 6" to their Move characteristic for that Movement phase instead of rolling a dice

chars: Add 3" to the range of any abilities on your Warlord’s datasheet (such as Aura of Discipline or Voice of Command).

chars: If this warlord charges in the charge phase, add 1 to their attacks characteristic until the end of the ensuing fight phase.

profiles.name: Inspiring Leader
chars: Friendly units within 6" of this warlord can add 1 to their leadership characteristic.

profiles.name: Tenacious Survivor
chars: Roll a dice each time this warlord loses a wound. On a 6, the warlord shrugs off the damage and does not lose the wound.

chars: When attacking a BUILDING, change the Hades Breaching Drill's Attacks to 2D6 and the Damage of the melta-cutter drill to D6.

chars: During deployment, you can set this unit up underground instead of placing it on the battlefield. At the end of any of your Movement phases, this unit may drill up from the ground and into battle - set it up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 9" away from enemy models.

profiles.name: Seperate Orders
chars: The first time this unit is set up, the Hades Breaching Drill Squadron must be deployed as a single group with each model within 2" of at least one other model from their unit. From that point on, the Hades Breaching Drill operates independently from the unit of Veterans and both are treated as separate units for all rules purposes.

profiles.name: Whirling Blades
chars: The Hades Breaching Drill has a 4+ invulnerable save in the Fight phase.

profiles.name: Melta Cutter Drill
chars: When making attacks against a VEHICLE, roll D6 for damage instead of D3.

profiles.name: Chainsword
chars: Each time the bearer fights, it can make 1 additional attack with this weapon.

profiles.name: Power fist
chars: When attacking with this weapon, you must subtract 1 from the hit roll.

profiles.name: Plasma pistol, Supercharge
chars: On a hit roll of 1, the bearer is slain.

profiles.name: Shotgun
chars: Add 1 to this weapons strength if within 1/2 range.

profiles.name: Plasma gun, Supercharge
chars: On a hit roll of 1, the bearer is slain after all of this weapon's shots have been resolved.

profiles.name: Meltagun
chars: When resolving an attack with this weapon against a target that is within half range, roll two D6 when inflicting damage with it and discard one of the results.

profiles.name: Flamer
chars: This weapon automatically hits its target.

profiles.name: R1: Sharpshooters
chars: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 for this unit in the Shooting phase.

profiles.name: R1: Agile
chars: You can re-roll Advance and Charge rolls for this unit.

profiles.name: R1: Deadeye Shots
chars: Each time you roll an unmodified wound roll of 6 for an attack with one of this unit’s ranged weapons, increase the Damage characteristic of that attack by 1.

profiles.name: R1: Grizzled
chars: This unit ignores penalties to their Leadership characteristic.

profiles.name: R2: Combat Specialists
chars: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 for this unit in the Fight phase.

chars: Add 1 to wound rolls for attacks made by models in this unit that target an enemy CHARACTER unit.

profiles.name: R3: Trophy Takers
chars: Subtract 1 from the Leadership characteristic of enemy units while they are within 6" of this unit.

profiles.name: R4: Disciplined
chars: This unit can shoot or charge during a turn in which it Fell Back.

profiles.name: R5: Brutal
chars: Add 1 to the Strength and Attacks characteristic of models in this unit during any turn in which they made a successful charge move.

profiles.name: R2: Lucky
chars: Roll a D6 each time a model from this unit loses a wound; on a 6 the model does not lose that wound.

profiles.name: R3: Breachers
chars: Add 1 to wound rolls for attacks made by models in this unit if the target of those attacks is receiving the benefit of cover.

chars: After this model completes a charge move, roll a D6 for each enemy unit within 1" of it. On a 4+ that unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

profiles.name: R1: Monstrous Regeneration
chars: This model regains 1 lost wound at the start of each of your turns.

profiles.name: R2: Terrifying
chars: Subtract 1 from the Leadership characteristic of enemy units while they are within 6" of this model.

profiles.name: R2: Lashing Limbs
chars: Each time you roll an unmodified saving throw of 6 for this model in the Fight phase, the enemy unit that made that attack suffers 1 mortal wound after it has resolved all of its attacks.

profiles.name: R3: Inhuman Resilience
chars: Roll a D6 each time a model in this unit loses a wound; on a 5+ the model does not lose that wound

profiles.name: R3: Sweeping Blows
chars: Each unmodified hit roll of 6 made for this model’s attacks in the Fight phase score 2 hits instead of 1.

profiles.name: R4: Juggernaut
chars: You can re-roll charge rolls for this model.

profiles.name: R5: Just Making it Angry
chars: If this model has a damage table, double the number of wounds it has remaining for the purposes of determining what its Strength and Attacks characteristics are.

profiles.name: R5: Eager
chars: At the start of the first battle round but before the first turn begins, you can move this model up to 5". It cannot end this move within 9" of any enemy models. If both players have units that can do this, the player who is taking the first turn moves their units first.

profiles.name: R1: Famed Commander
chars: Roll a D6 each time a model in this unit loses a wound; on a 6 the model does not lose that wound.

profiles.name: R1: Skilled Driver
chars: You can re-roll Advance rolls for this unit.

profiles.name: R2: Experimental Ammunition
chars: Select one of the ranged weapons used by one or more models in this unit. Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of that weapon for attacks made by that unit.

profiles.name: R2: Advanced Targeting
chars: Add 6" to the maximum range of this unit’s Heavy and Rapid Fire weapons that have an unmodified maximum range of 24" or longer.

profiles.name: R3: Ablative Armor
chars: Attacks against this unit that have an AP characteristic of -1 are treated as having an AP characteristic of 0 instead.

profiles.name: R3: Storied Vehicle
chars: You can re-roll one hit roll or wound roll for this unit in each of your Shooting phases.

profiles.name: R4: Blessed Drive
chars: If this model has a damage table, double the number of wounds it has remaining for the purposes of determining what its Move characteristic is.

profiles.name: R4: Last Resort
chars: If a model in this unit is destroyed, the controlling player can choose for it to automatically explode – no dice roll is required.

profiles.name: R5: Prominent Trophy
chars: Add 1 to the Leadership characteristic of friendly units while they are within 6" of this unit. Subtract 1 from the Leadership characteristic of enemy units while they are within 6" of this unit.

profiles.name: R5: Blessed Weapons
chars: If this model has a damage table, double the number of wounds it has remaining for the purposes of determining what its Ballistic Skill characteristic is.

profiles.name: Master of Ballistics
chars: You can re-roll any hit rolls of 1 made for friendly <REGIMENT> BASILISKS, WYVERNS, MANTICORES or DEATHSTRIKES when they target enemy units over 36" away in the Shooting phase, if they are within 6" of this model.

chars: This weapon can only be fired once per battle, and cannot be used if the bearer moves. This weapon can target units that are not visible to the bearer (when doing so, subtract 1 from the hit rolls). You may only use one artillery barrage per turn, regardless of how many Masters of Ordnance you have in your army.

chars: This unit may issue one order per turn to the soldiers under their command at the start of their Shooting phase. Orders may only be issued to INFANTRY units within 6" of this unit that have the same <REGIMENT> keyword as this unit. To issue an order, pick a target unit and choose which order you wish to issue from the table below. A unit may only be affected by one order per turn.

On a 4+ the bearer can immediately issue another order to the same unit. This does not count towards the maximum number of orders this model may issue each turn.

profiles.name: The Dagger of Tu'Sakh
chars: During deployment, you can set up the bearer and one ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY unit from your army behind enemy lines instead of placing them on the battlefield. chars: MILITARUM TEMPESTUS model only. When using the Voice of Command ability, this model can issue one additional order per turn. Roll a dice before issuing this additional order. On a roll of 1, the Reliquary issues contradictory nonsense and nothing happens.

profiles.name: The Emperor's Benediction
chars: COMMISSAR or LORD COMMISSAR with a bolt pistol only. The Emperor’s Benediction replaces the model’s bolt pistol and has the following profile:

profiles.name: The Emperor's Benediction
chars: This weapon can target a Character even if it is not the closest enemy unit, unless the bearer is within 1" of an enemy unit.

profiles.name: Skull Mask of Acheron
chars: ARMAGEDDON CHARACTER only. Enemy units within 3" of the bearer suffer a -1 penalty to their Leadership. ORK units suffer a -2 penalty instead.

profiles.name: Kurov's Aquila
chars: OFFICERS only. Each time your opponent uses a Stratagem, roll a D6. On a 5+ you gain 1 Command Point.

chars: If the bearer is targeted or affected by a psychic power, roll a D6; on a 2+ the psychic power has no effect on the bearer.

profiles.name: Litanies of The Holy Synod
chars: If a friendly EMPEROR’S CONCLAVE unit within 6" of the bearer takes a Morale test, roll two D6 and use the lowest result to determine the outcome of the Morale test. In addition, if the bearer is slain, before removing the model from the battlefield, pick another friendly EMPEROR’S CONCLAVE unit within 6" of the bearer. For the rest of the battle that unit does not have to take Morale tests and can add 1 to its Attacks characteristic.

profiles.name: Agripinaa-Class Orbital Tracker
chars: In your Shooting phase, pick an EMPEROR’S WRATH unit from your army within 6" of the bearer. Until the end of that phase, enemy units do not receive the benefit of cover when targeted by shooting attacks made by that unit.

chars: This Warlord can perform a Heroic Intervention if, after the enemy has completed all their charge moves, they are within 6" of any enemy units. chars: Use this Stratagem before the battle if you used any Specialist Detachment Stratagems when choosing your army.
